what_it_does: Asian Paints Ltd manufactures and sells paints, coatings, home decor products, and provides related services. It operates globally across decorative and industrial segments through various brands and subsidiaries.

segments.name: Sleek - Kitchens and Wardrobes
segments.comment: Modular kitchen solutions, components, and wardrobes operating across 305 stores.

segments.name: Bath Fittings and Sanitaryware
segments.comment: Operates via Bathsense and ESSESS brands in premium and value segments.

segments.name: Non-automotive industrial coatings (APPPG)
segments.comment: Protective coatings, powder coatings, and traffic solutions via joint venture with PPG.

scale: Operations in 13 countries across four regions
24 subsidiary companies and 2 joint venture companies
geography: Domestic and international operations across 13 countries in Asia, Middle East, Africa, and South Pacific.
